original_target.title: A periodic nonsingular billiard trajectory in every triangle

scope_comparison: The source claims a regular periodic billiard path in every finite bounded polygon. Every nondegenerate triangle is included. Regularity excludes vertices and tangencies; the phase-space orbit is closed, so both position and direction repeat. The doubling construction may increase the period, which the local existential target permits.
